hypotheses.W1_residual_metric_removes_raw_outlier: Direct residual-dual top-one share is at least 0.20 lower than raw-logit top-one share on held-out data.
hypotheses.W2_logit_dual_removes_raw_outlier: The dual/whitened-logit top-one share is at least 0.20 lower than raw-logit top-one share on held-out data.
hypotheses.W3_residual_metric_has_shared_structure: Residual-dual top-four share exceeds its per-context rotation-null p95 by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.W4_metric_specific_subspaces_transfer: Every metric's top-four subspace has discovery-to-evaluation overlap at least 0.80.
hypotheses.W5_metric_choice_changes_the_leading_axi: Raw-logit leading-axis squared cosine with both residual-dual and logit-dual leading axes is below 0.80.
